violations.text: Utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Per staff interview, equipment is washed and rinsed only. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Inspector reviewed proper sanitizing procedures for mixing a chlorine sanitizing solution and a handout was given at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Salt water taffy and chocolate packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Candy was removed from self-service at time of inspection. Candy must not be made available for self service until labels are made. Please email inspector proof of correction. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The floors, walls, and ceiling throughout the basement have an accumulation of soil residue, dust and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back of store, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Establishment is to install new weather stripping or door sweep. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024
